records.name: BixBench v1.5, Harbor CLI
records.description: notebook-derived biological analysis questions
notes: Access: Public reference answers and adapter; validate inputs and environment.

Grading: Together openai/gpt-oss-120b; original comparison prompt, explicit JSON schema, 1,024-token cap, 600 s verifier limit. Retained 177 native grades; 10 of 11 failed grading calls recovered. Numerical tolerances unchanged; pilot precision caveat remains.
Limitations: First primary-suite candidate: existing Harbor adapter. CLI and replacement-judge scores need explicit protocol labels.

records.name: BixBench-Verified-50, Harbor CLI
records.description: 50 bioinformatics analysis questions across 33 capsules; Phylo-curated subset.
notes: Access: Public pinned Harbor tasks, references and grader; public hash-verified capsules. Phylo source files require HF access for regeneration.
Grading: decimal-precision-v1 for 13 continuous targets; Together GPT-OSS-120B for remaining answers; explicit JSON schema, 1,024-token cap.
Limitations: Curated 50-question subset; two known source defects retained. Harbor grading differs from Phylo; scores are not interchangeable with original BixBench.

records.name: Terminal-Bench-Science, life sciences
records.description: scientific workflows
notes: Access: Task files, fixtures, and oracle available; one Harbor/Daytona oracle passed.
Grading: Executable task verifier; genomic-model-ranking needs no judge API.
Limitations: Prepared smoke test, not a suite score. Diagnostic agent limit 15 minutes versus native 8 hours.

records.name: ScienceAgentBench, bioinformatics
records.description: Python analysis and scientific computing
notes: Access: Separate SharePoint inputs and gold assets; some tasks need GPU or extra RAM.
Grading: 27 bio tasks: 11 deterministic, 16 visual. Visual grader defaults to GPT-4o; replacement needs validation.
Limitations: Next existing adapter. Choose tasks by relevance/resources; visual tasks remain eligible.

records.name: scBench
records.description: single-cell analysis from workflow snapshots
notes: Access: Six public task configs/targets; Latch data pointers untested. Full suite withheld.
Grading: Six public examples use numeric tolerances; shared grader library is public.
Limitations: Public-subset score only. Pinned repo: 195 total / 6 public; paper: 394 / 30.

records.name: GeneBench-Pro
records.description: judgment-heavy genomics and quantitative biology
notes: Access: Ten ungated public cases with references and schemas; full 129-task suite not in release.
Grading: Python standard-library numeric, integer, exact-match checks; 30 local interface checks passed.
Limitations: 10/10 reports document generation and estimators. Public pass rates: GLM-5.1 0%; GLM-5.2 8.9%; GLM-5.3 unmeasured. Teacher reliability is the MVP gate.

records.name: SpatialBench
records.description: spatial transcriptomics analysis
notes: Access: 16 public task JSONs; Latch downloads untested. Full 159-task suite withheld.
Grading: Inspected examples include deterministic configs and targets; shared Latch grader code.
Limitations: Complementary spatial analysis. Report the exact public subset separately from full-suite results.

records.name: BioAgent Bench
records.description: ten bioinformatics pipelines, including RNA-seq, variant calling, and metagenomics; corrupted-input, decoy-file, and prompt perturbations
notes: Access: Public data downloader and reference pipelines; runtime/memory staging untested.
Grading: Deterministic results_match plus LLM progress judge; keep scores separate. Default judge uses OpenRouter.
Limitations: Pipeline execution and perturbation robustness. Paper targets <4 hours / 48 GB; not measured pilot costs.

records.name: sc-HeurekaBench
records.description: open-ended single-cell scientific reasoning
notes: Access: Released evaluator; 50 open-ended and 50 multiple-choice questions. Data access untested.
Grading: Open answers: LLM judge (default GPT-4o). MCQ: exact option-set accuracy plus precision/recall/F1.
Limitations: Single-cell scientific reasoning; report open-answer and MC results separately.

records.family_name: Liu et al. single-cell agent benchmark
records.name: Liu et al., single-cell agent benchmark
records.description: 50 single-cell and multi-omics tasks
notes: Access: Public evaluation code and reference analyses for 50 tasks; downloads/scorer untested.
Grading: LLM evaluation plus output consistency, code, execution, and knowledge-use metrics.
Limitations: Workflow diagnostics. Separate from BioAgent Bench; process metrics do not establish biological correctness.

records.name: BAISBench
records.description: single-cell annotation and data-grounded biological discovery
notes: Access: Public notebooks: 15 annotated datasets; 193 MC questions from 41 studies.
Grading: Annotation metrics and MC reference answers; validate end-to-end extraction/scoring.
Limitations: Single-cell annotation and discovery are separate evaluation targets and metrics.

records.name: BioML-bench
records.description: biomedical ML engineering across omics, proteins, imaging, and drug discovery
notes: Access: Alpha release; dataset permissions/reference labels vary by source.
Grading: Released numerical scorers; inspected examples use F1 and Pearson correlation.
Limitations: Complementary biomedical ML engineering; budget model fitting separately from agent inference.

records.name: LABBench2
records.description: broad research skills, including literature, sequences, and cloning
notes: Access: Gated HF dataset; released evaluators and external reference files.
Grading: Sequence/cloning executable checks; other categories use LLM judging, defaulting to Anthropic.
Limitations: Broader research skills. Harbor labbench covers original FigQA, not LABBench2.

records.name: CompBioBench
records.description: 100 tasks across omics, genetics, and ML
notes: Access: Public runner/inputs; HF login and answers to all 100 questions for hosted scoring; 2 submissions/day at audit.
Grading: Hosted exact-match scoring. Community verifier only collects answers; its fixed reward=0 is not correctness.
Limitations: Community packaging covers 100 tasks; official hosted scoring remains necessary.

records.name: BixBench3
records.description: 20 research-scale analyses from raw data
notes: Access: Gated HF dataset; reference artifact packages on GCS; full downloads untested.
Grading: Deterministic artifact scoring; separate LLM process review. Default runner uses OpenAI.
Limitations: Later study-scale evaluation: 20 analyses. Keep artifact and process scores separate.

records.name: BioMysteryBench
records.description: analysis of anonymized biological datasets
notes: Access: 90 gated, eval-only tasks; 5 previews. Community importer skips >1 GB archives by default.
Grading: Community LLM judge uses answer rubric + trajectory/source-lookup compliance; official equivalence unvalidated.
Limitations: Packaging and a community judge exist; access, judge fidelity and source-lookup compliance remain blockers.

records.name: BioXArena
creators: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
records.description: 76 biomedical ML tasks across nine domains
notes: Access: Public runner/inputs for 76 tasks; no verified complete local scorer.
Grading: Authors score predictions against private answers.csv; numerical metrics.
Limitations: Biomedical ML across 9 domains; agent inference and task model fitting have separate costs.

records.name: EpiBench
records.description: epigenomics workflow steps across accessibility, chromatin, and methylation assays
notes: Access: 7 public examples with Latch pointers; full paper suite has 106 tasks.
Grading: Official targets missing; community reconstructs deterministic checks for 7 public examples.
Limitations: Community packaging covers 7 examples; reconstructed grading must be reported as a separate variant.

records.name: SpatialBench-Long
records.description: study-scale spatial biological inference
notes: Access: 4 public examples include prompts/vocabularies but omit graders and targets; Latch inputs.
Grading: Deterministic final answers plus separate LLM trajectory rubrics in paper.
Limitations: Later long-workflow comparison. Public examples do not establish full-suite reproducibility.

records.name: VariantBench
records.description: Variant discovery/QC, statistical genetics and personal genomics; 118 main evaluations.
notes: Access: 8 public eval JSONs with graders/targets and Latch pointers; 28 example trajectories. Includes 2 ancillary cases outside main118.
Grading: Deterministic typed endpoint checks; composite tasks require all fields to pass.
Limitations: Adds variant interpretation absent from existing Latch rows. Full-suite access and data downloads still need validation.

records.name: scBench-Long
records.description: 21 long-horizon single-cell evaluations across 5 study systems.
notes: Access: 4 public examples with prompt/vocabulary files and trajectories; public release does not establish full-suite scoring access.
Grading: Paper: deterministic final answers plus separate trajectory rubrics.
Limitations: Separate from short-step scBench and SpatialBench-Long; end-to-end claim recovery.

records.name: TxBench-PP — preclinical pharmacology
records.description: 100 assay-grounded preclinical pharmacology decisions.
notes: Access: 12 public eval JSONs in audited tree, all with graders and data pointers; README still says7.
Grading: Released Latch deterministic graders, including numeric, label, ranking and composite checks.
Limitations: Drug-discovery reasoning coverage. Some tasks need image inspection; filter explicitly for text-only served models.

records.name: TxBench-Ab — antibody discovery
records.description: 100 evaluations across 10 antibody-discovery competencies.
notes: Access: 6 public eval.json files audited; README says7. Input bundles, graders and targets absent from inspected configs.
Grading: Paper describes deterministic decision/endpoint scoring; public metadata names grader types.
Limitations: New September2026 release. Images may be essential for some assays; protocol is explicitly offline.

records.name: TxBench-OD — oligonucleotide discovery
records.description: 113 ASO/siRNA discovery decision tasks.
notes: Access: 4 public eval.json files audited; README says7. Inputs and executable graders absent from inspected configs.
Grading: Deterministic decisions from supplied experimental evidence; full scoring assets needed.
Limitations: September9,2026 release; direct answer to internet constraint: task execution is explicitly offline.

records.name: BioSecBench-Surveillance
records.description: 100 defensive pathogen-surveillance analysis evaluations.
notes: Access: 7 public metadata/prompt examples; input nodes, graders, ground truth and trajectories withheld.
Grading: Deterministic endpoint pass/fail; timeouts fail; refusals excluded from pass-rate denominator.
Limitations: Track for completeness; access prevents a reproducible public Harbor implementation.

records.name: BioSecBench-Function
records.description: 111 defensive functional-interpretation evaluations.
notes: Access: 7 public descriptive examples; data, graders, ground truth and trajectories withheld.
Grading: Deterministic functional endpoint scoring; refusals reported separately.
Limitations: Completeness/access-tracking candidate. Official methods explicitly disable internet.

records.name: BioSecBench-Refusal — direct framing
records.description: 107 paired routine/hazard-detection scenarios; direct and meta framings.
notes: Access: 2 public examples; full107 tasks, hazard rationales and data restricted; no trajectories.
Grading: Direct: API-block detection plus trajectory refusal judge. Meta: deterministic decision/rationale scoring.
Limitations: Measures appropriate refusal/hazard recognition, not ordinary biology accuracy. Keep separate from capability aggregate.

records.name: Terminal-Bench-Science-lite — upcoming
records.description: Upcoming science-lite life-sciences slice; composition pending release.
notes: Access: Planning entry only; distinct from existing public Terminal-Bench-Science smoke test.
Grading: Expected Harbor task verifiers; exact release and task assets not yet available.
Limitations: Planning document explicitly says Science-lite should be OOD. Do not reuse inspected public tasks as a clean holdout.

records.name: SciCode — biology (Harbor variant)
records.description: Scientific coding; biology among 5 domains and 16 subdomains.
notes: Access: Existing Harbor adapter; shared≈1GB HDF5 test data staged once. Test solutions not publicly released.
Grading: Executable scientific test cases; main/subproblem reporting must match chosen protocol.
Limitations: AAII4.3 OOD component. Harbor's agentic variant changes the execution protocol; do not present it as canonical AAII performance.

records.name: BiomniBench-DA
records.description: Paper: 100 biomedical data-analysis tasks across 17 types, 5 disease areas, and general biology.
notes: Access: HF metadata lists 50 Harbor-style task directories with instructions, Dockerfiles, and tests at e1c8ca5e11a620087bc48d97888eb69176a1f235. Auto-gated; unauthenticated content fetch returned 401.
Grading: Process-level scoring against expert task-specific rubrics; llm_judge.py and rubric.txt listed for all 50 released tasks. Judge provider and scoring contract unverified.
Limitations: Harbor-style packaging is listed but execution is unvalidated. Adds process diagnostics beyond final-answer checks. Distinguish the 50-task release from the paper's 100 tasks.

records.name: DrugDiscoveryBench
records.description: 82 early-stage drug-discovery tasks across 7 capabilities, using scientific databases, chemistry, genetics and literature.
notes: Access: Public Harbor tasks; reference answers/rubrics require gated ScaleAI/DrugDiscoveryBench access.
Grading: LLM rubric judge; weighted outcome score 0–100, pass only at 100; process rubric reported separately.
Limitations: Official Harbor release; promising comparison candidate. Community Daytona importer has a syntax error at the audited pin.

records.name: PromptBio-Bench
records.description: 244 tasks: 131 bioinformatics + 113 data science; 27 subfields and varied difficulty.
notes: Access: 244 public task/eval JSON pairs and reference-script directories; input/reference files on ungated HF; evaluator on GitHub.
Grading: LLM-assisted file matching/strategy selection + format-specific comparison; mean file similarity (0–1).
Limitations: Useful MVP candidate with reference scripts for sibling validation. Some tasks are elementary; choose a teacher/student gap. Score is not a binary pass rate.

records.name: LifeSciBench
records.description: 750 expert-authored tasks, 7 workflows and 7 domains; 1,062 artifacts and 19,020 rubric criteria.
notes: Access: Paper and examples public; full tasks, artifacts, rubrics and runnable scorer not located. Release may be restricted.
Grading: Task-specific weighted rubrics; mean normalized score and pass rate at a 70% threshold; automated/model-assisted grading.
Limitations: Single user request permits unrestricted browsing; not a tool-free protocol. Broad applied research, not a measure of live discovery impact.

records.name: GeneBench — original
records.description: Multi-stage quantitative genomics: noisy data, QC, statistical models, confounding and downstream inference.
notes: Access: Paper and worked example available; full original benchmark assets/scorer not verified.
Grading: Quantitative reference answers with task-specific checks; synthetic construction and ablations constrain valid solutions.
Limitations: Original OpenAI benchmark, separate from the GeneBench-Pro row. A public worked example is not the complete evaluation.

records.name: Biomni-Eval1 — tool-enabled
records.description: Biomni-Eval1 biomedical tasks spanning genetics, variants, literature and experimental reasoning.
notes: Access: Public biomni/Eval1 data and evaluator in the Biomni agent repository.
Grading: Official BiomniEval1 task-specific evaluator; answer matching/structured-output checks vary by task.
Limitations: Some tasks overlap existing benchmark families such as LAB-Bench. Stars/citations describe the broader Biomni project.

records.name: CellBench (CellVoyager)
records.description: CellBench: single-cell analysis planning derived from research workflows, evaluated with CellVoyager and base LLMs.
notes: Access: CellVoyager repository contains CellBench evaluation scripts and judged outputs.
Grading: Plan-quality evaluation against research-derived references; judge configuration requires validation.
Limitations: Agent protocol recorded here; base-LLM results are a different protocol. Repository stars cover the whole CellVoyager project.

records.name: SciGym
records.description: Systems-biology dry lab: infer hidden reaction mechanisms from interventions on 350 SBML systems.
notes: Access: Public simulator/evaluation code and small/large evaluation datasets.
Grading: Simulator-grounded recovery of system structure/parameters; use the task’s official metrics.
Limitations: Controlled simulated experiments, not wet-lab execution; do not pool small/large tracks without reporting them.

records.name: BioKGBench
records.description: Biomedical knowledge-graph verification and question answering with scientific evidence.
notes: Access: Public BioKGBench code and author-linked dataset.
Grading: Task-specific knowledge/claim verification and QA scoring; reproduce official evidence and answer checks.
Limitations: Graph verification and question answering test different abilities; report both. Live sources can change reproducibility.

records.name: TargetVal (Popper)
records.description: Drug-target hypothesis validation with Popper’s sequential statistical experiments.
notes: Access: Public POPPER code and linked TargetVal evaluation data/setup.
Grading: Hypothesis decisions supported by sequential falsification/statistical testing; preserve error-control protocol.
Limitations: TargetVal is the benchmark within the larger Popper project; stars/citations cover the full project/paper.

records.name: DiscoveryBench — biology
records.description: Data-driven scientific discovery; biology slice of 264 real tasks, with a separate synthetic collection.
notes: Access: Public datasets and evaluation code on GitHub/HF.
Grading: Facet-based hypothesis comparison with model-assisted grading against reference discoveries.
Limitations: Real and synthetic tasks are separate tracks; the whole benchmark count is not the biology count.

records.name: ScholarQABench — biomedicine
records.description: Biomedical scientific literature retrieval and long-form synthesis in ScholarQABench/OpenScholar.
notes: Access: Public ScholarQABench benchmark repository; retrieval corpus/index and evaluator setup required.
Grading: Answer quality, evidence/citation and task-specific reference grading; some scoring uses model judges.
Limitations: Suite reuses tasks including SciFact and PubMedQA; mark overlap rather than count all as independent evidence.

records.name: CORE-Bench — biomedical papers
records.description: Computational reproducibility of biomedical papers within 270 tasks from 90 papers across three fields.
notes: Access: Public benchmark/harness and linked computational capsules; dependencies and capsule access must be checked.
Grading: Reference result checks, including numeric tolerances; all task questions must meet the chosen success rule.
Limitations: Easy/medium/hard reveal different code/environment information. Some capsules require substantial compute.

records.name: ABC-Bench (SecureBio)
records.description: SecureBio agentic biological capability tasks, including scientific automation and bioinformatics.
notes: Access: Public paper/methodology; full task assets and scoring release not verified.
Grading: Task-specific programmatic/reference assessment in the published agentic protocol.
Limitations: SecureBio ABC-Bench is not the similarly named backend-coding ABC-Bench adapter.

records.name: ABLE — agentic biological AI tool use
records.description: Nine evaluation tasks for LLM planning and use of biological AI/protein-design tools.
notes: Access: Paper/methodology public; complete evaluation assets/access not verified.
Grading: Task-specific algorithmic assessment of tool use and outputs; expert baselines reported.
Limitations: Evaluates LLM use of biological tools; it is not a standalone protein sequence-model benchmark.

records.name: Bio-Task Bench — original tasks
records.description: 34 original executable biological tasks across 10 domains in Bio-Task Bench.
notes: Access: Public original tasks, runners and tests; external benchmark adapters also present.
Grading: Task-specific deterministic tests over produced outputs.
Limitations: Count original tasks separately from adapters to other benchmark families; repository coverage is not all independent data.

records.name: LAB-Bench — tool-enabled literature / database
records.description: LAB-Bench literature/database retrieval tasks, including LitQA2, DbQA and SuppQA.
notes: Access: Public subset and evaluator; tool/API/corpus access depends on retrieval configuration.
Grading: Official multiple-choice accuracy, precision and coverage; preserve abstention.
Limitations: Tool-enabled protocol of LAB-Bench v1, not LABBench2. A FigQA adapter does not implement this retrieval protocol.

records.name: BioASQ — retrieval / end-to-end QA
records.description: BioASQ biomedical document/snippet retrieval and end-to-end question answering.
notes: Access: Public evaluation tools and annual data; corpus/index and challenge access need staging.
Grading: Official retrieval ranking metrics plus task-specific exact/ideal answer scores.
Limitations: Retrieval plus QA is a distinct protocol from supplied-evidence QA; do not combine scores without naming the track.

records.name: BixBench — original notebook protocols
records.description: Original BixBench notebook-based data analysis; current v1.5 has 205 questions from 60 capsules.
notes: Access: Public authors’ notebook environment, configuration, grading scripts and HF release.
Grading: Open-answer model grading or exact MCQ matching; majority vote/replicas are optional protocol choices.
Limitations: Same benchmark family as Harbor CLI row but a different execution interface; do not count notebook/CLI as independent tasks.

records.name: LAB-Bench — tool-free text MCQ
records.description: Protocol reasoning, sequence manipulation, cloning; text-only subsets.
notes: Access: Public slices: ProtocolQA108, SeqQA600, CloningScenarios33; evaluator released. Private holdout excluded.
Grading: Official generation protocol: accuracy, precision and coverage with abstention. Likelihood scoring is a separately labelled variant.
Limitations: Direct research-skill complement to MMLU. FigQA/TableQA require images; literature/database slices test a different retrieval burden.

records.name: Genome-Bench
records.description: CRISPR/genome-editing knowledge and experimental reasoning; 5-choice MCQ.
notes: Access: Public dataset: 3,332 items (2,671 train / 661 test).
Grading: Accuracy on the final a–e choice; optional generated explanation scored separately.
Limitations: Knowledge/protocol QA, not raw genomic sequence prediction. Forum-derived and model-assisted construction need contamination and label checks.

records.name: BioProBench — PQA / ERR
records.description: Protocol MCQ and context-dependent step-error detection.
notes: Access: Public JSON tests: 1,200 PQA and 1,200 ERR items at the audited revision; scorer code available.
Grading: PQA exact choice accuracy + confidence Brier score; ERR accuracy/precision/recall/F1. No LLM judge for these slices.
Limitations: Procedural reasoning beyond broad biology facts. Current release differs from the older paper; pin dataset, prompts and scorer together.

records.name: BLURB — non-QA task families
records.description: 13 datasets / 6 task families: NER, PICO, relations, similarity, classification and QA.
notes: Access: Public task pages, data and baseline code; QA subsets listed separately below.
Grading: Task-specific F1/accuracy/correlation. Original fine-tuned encoder aggregate is not directly comparable to prompted LLMs.
Limitations: Useful biomedical NLP coverage but not a single MCQ benchmark. Do not double-count the QA rows in a BLURB aggregate.

records.name: MMLU — biology / biomedical subjects
records.description: School/college biology, medical genetics, anatomy and clinical/medical knowledge; 4-choice MCQ.
notes: Access: Public data and native YAMLs for seven subjects. Three-subject biology integration validated with GLM-5.3 (554/554); four optional biomedical subjects remain unrun.
Grading: Native multiple-choice likelihood accuracy; preserve Marin's 5-shot protocol.
Limitations: Low-effort biology baseline with optional biomedical coverage. Existing ID exposure and possible saturation; keep clinical subjects out of the pooled biology score.

records.name: MMLU-Pro — biology
records.description: Harder biology MCQ with up to 10 options.
notes: Access: Native MMLUPro class; public TIGER-Lab/MMLU-Pro category metadata.
Grading: Generated-answer extraction and accuracy; implementation already returns category statistics.
Limitations: Low effort category reporting from an existing Marin ID eval. Keep separate from MMLU.

records.name: GPQA Diamond — biology
records.description: Graduate-level biology reasoning; 4-choice MCQ.
notes: Access: Native GPQADiamond base task; gated dataset access/terms. Full Diamond=198, biology count must be derived from metadata.
Grading: Native generated-answer accuracy; preserve option shuffle, seeds and 3-sample aggregation.
Limitations: Existing Marin ID eval. Subset uncertainty will be wider than full Diamond; no reclassification to OOD.

records.name: PubMedQA — labeled abstract QA
records.description: Biomedical question + abstract context; yes/no/maybe.
notes: Access: 1,000 expert-labeled PQA-L examples; native bigbio labeled-fold0 train/validation/test config.
Grading: Native likelihood accuracy over yes/no/maybe; deterministic reference label.
Limitations: Direct BLURB QA slice and reference from Genome-Bench. Cheap offline biomedical reading baseline; original split matters.

records.name: BioASQ — supplied-snippet yes/no
records.description: Biomedical literature QA with provided supporting snippets.
notes: Access: BioASQ task data and BLURB preprocessing; source-specific access/registration may apply.
Grading: Yes/no accuracy for the BLURB-style QA slice; retain official split/scorer.
Limitations: Offline reading candidate. Full BioASQ retrieval and ideal-answer tasks are different protocols.

records.name: BioLP-bench
records.description: Identify consequential errors in laboratory protocols.
notes: Access: Public Inspect implementation and protocol CSV; separate model judge/API required.
Grading: Official implementation uses model_graded_qa; default self-grading is unreliable for weaker models.
Limitations: Followed BioProBench references. Strong procedural diagnostic, but not a deterministic MCQ drop-in.

records.name: SciKnowEval v2 — biology closed-choice
records.description: Scientific biology knowledge/reasoning across difficulty levels.
notes: Access: Public v2 release: 28,392 examples / 58 tasks across 4 domains; biology-slice count needs metadata aggregation.
Grading: Closed-choice accuracy only for this slice; other tasks can require GPT judging or embedding models.
Limitations: Adds biological breadth beyond exam questions. Do not silently omit judge-requiring tasks from a claimed full-suite score.

records.name: GenomeQA — sequence understanding
records.description: Raw DNA sequence classification across 6 task families; 5,200 examples.
notes: Access: Paper accessible; no author-linked runnable release located in this audit.
Grading: Task-label classification metrics; reproduce the paper's task-level protocol.
Limitations: Native sequence capability complement to Genome-Bench's text knowledge QA. Distinct from ClawBio's same-name agent benchmark.

records.name: ProteinGym-LLM (PG-LLM)
records.description: Rank protein variants by measured fitness from full sequences and assay context.
notes: Access: Public code and evaluation data; primary protocol 217 assays × 3 seeds at N=50.
Grading: Spearman rho within assay; equal-weight aggregation assay → protein → functional category.
Limitations: Native protein reasoning complement to text QA. Evaluation-only splits prohibit benchmark-specific training/tuning.

records.name: Humanity's Last Exam — biology/medicine
records.description: Frontier academic biology/medicine; text and multimodal question variants.
notes: Access: Native Evalchemy HLE class using cais/hle; public data is still protected by Marin's OOD policy.
Grading: Native HLE generation + answer judge; preserve exact variant, image filter and grading settings.
Limitations: Relevant AAII 4.3 component. A biology slice is a proposed derived report, not a separately approved canonical AAII score.

records.name: AA-Omniscience — biology/health slice
records.description: Factual recall, abstention and hallucination in biology/health.
notes: Access: Full benchmark 6,000 questions / 42 topics / 6 domains; public preview is not the full canonical suite.
Grading: Official correctness/abstention judge; report accuracy, hallucination and signed Omniscience Index.
Limitations: AAII 4.3 OOD component. Health includes clinical knowledge; confirm topic mapping before calling it a biology score.

records.name: BioPlanner / BioProt
records.description: Biological protocol planning and next-step prediction using the BioProt protocol corpus.
notes: Access: Public BioProt data, prompts and evaluation code in the authors’ repository.
Grading: Automatic protocol/action-sequence evaluation; reproduce task-specific reference matching and planning metrics.
Limitations: Planning text/pseudocode is not physical protocol execution. Keep next-step and full-plan results separate.

records.name: BioCoder
records.description: Bioinformatics function generation in Python/Java and related programming tasks.
notes: Access: Public code, testing framework and author-linked HF release.
Grading: Executable correctness tests, including fuzz testing; pass@k depends on sampling and test configuration.
Limitations: One-shot code generation is the stated protocol; code execution by the grader does not itself make the model agentic.

records.name: HumanEval-BioImage (human-eval-bia)
creators: Max Planck Institute for Human Cognitive and Brain Sciences
records.description: 57 Python function-completion problems for bioimage analysis.
notes: Access: Public task definitions, reference solutions and tests in human-eval-bia.
Grading: Unit-test correctness and pass@k; pin Python/image-analysis dependencies.
Limitations: Small function-level suite; distinct from an autonomous microscopy analysis workflow.

records.name: BioLLMBench
records.description: 24 tasks in 6 bioinformatics skill areas, including knowledge, mathematics, coding, plots and summarization.
notes: Access: Paper identified; no authoritative complete runnable dataset/scorer release located in this audit.
Grading: Task-specific assessment, including expert review and code/output evaluation; executable scoring contract unverified.
Limitations: Paper-reported evaluation suite. Mixed task formats cannot be reduced to one MCQ accuracy.

records.name: Bioinfo-Bench
records.description: Bioinformatics knowledge acquisition, analysis and application across 10 domains.
notes: Access: Author repository and public Qiyuan04/bioinfo-bench dataset; schema/scorer need validation.
Grading: Task-specific QA/analysis evaluation; validate released reference fields and answer normalization.
Limitations: Distinct from BioinformaticsBench and BioLLMBench despite similar names.

records.name: BioinformaticsBench
records.description: 602 human-annotated questions across 9 bioinformatics domains; MCQ, true/false and open questions.
notes: Access: OpenReview paper available; complete author-linked data/scorer not located.
Grading: Question-type-specific correctness; open-response judge and reproducible scorer need verification.
Limitations: Catalogued separately from Bioinfo-Bench; reported task count does not establish a runnable public release.

records.name: GeneTuring
records.description: Genomic factual knowledge: gene names, locations, functions and associations; repository lists 16 modules.
notes: Access: Public benchmark/reference materials and model-output collections in GeneTuring.
Grading: Reference-based QA correctness; pin module definitions and answer normalization.
Limitations: This row is direct LLM QA. GeneGPT/tool-augmented runs require a separately specified protocol; output-row counts are not task counts.

records.name: SC-Arena
records.description: Five single-cell language tasks: annotation, captioning, generation, perturbation prediction and QA.
notes: Access: Public evaluation repository and example data/configurations; complete data coverage needs validation.
Grading: Knowledge-augmented, task-specific metrics using ontology, marker and literature information.
Limitations: Language-model evaluation of single-cell reasoning; keep task metrics distinct and verify full versus example release.

records.name: BioMaze — tool-free reasoning
records.description: About 5,100 biological pathway reasoning problems, including judgments and open responses.
notes: Access: Public BioMaze code and author-linked HF questions/answers.
Grading: Reference correctness for judgments; model-assisted assessment for open responses.
Limitations: Tool-free row; the paper’s PathSeeker graph/tool workflow is a separate experimental condition.

records.name: CARDBiomedBench
records.description: Biomedical research QA with a focus on neurodegenerative disease and scientific evidence.
notes: Access: Public CARDBiomedBench code and HF release.
Grading: BioScore rubric/model-assisted response evaluation; grader identity and prompts must be pinned.
Limitations: Free-response research QA; rubric scores are not directly comparable to MCQ accuracy.

records.name: BiomedSQL
records.description: Text-to-SQL scientific queries against a biomedical knowledge base.
notes: Access: Public code and HF data; original execution workflow uses the CARD knowledge base/BigQuery.
Grading: SQL execution/result comparison against reference queries; database and comparison settings matter.
Limitations: Direct SQL generation recorded here; database execution is part of scoring. An iterative SQL agent is a separate protocol.

records.name: BABE (Biology Arena Benchmark)
records.description: Multimodal biology reasoning across 12 fields, with correlated and multi-hop causal question groups.
notes: Access: Paper found; authoritative full data/scorer release not located.
Grading: Paper-described question-group evaluation; executable scorer and exact judge configuration unverified.
Limitations: Keep linked question triplets together when defining splits; this is currently a paper-level inventory entry.

records.name: MicroVQA
records.description: 1,042 microscopy-based scientific reasoning questions with images and multiple-choice answers.
notes: Access: Public repository and author-linked HF benchmark.
Grading: Multiple-choice answer accuracy; preserve official option formatting and image inputs.
Limitations: Tests image-grounded reasoning; text-only substitution changes the benchmark.

records.name: Biology-Instructions — evaluation splits
records.description: Multi-omics sequence understanding across 21 classification/regression task types.
notes: Access: Stage3.xlsx released in the repository; training/inference code linked in MyTransformers.
Grading: Task-specific classification/regression metrics; pin held-out split and prompting setup.
Limitations: Actual instruction-following LLM evaluation; training corpus size is not benchmark size. Keep fine-tuning and evaluation protocols distinct.

records.name: Bio-benchmark — biological tasks
records.description: 30 prompted LLM tasks across bioinformatics/biomedical NLP, proteins, RNA, drugs and clinical records.
notes: Access: Paper identified; official consolidated data/scorer release not located.
Grading: Heterogeneous task-specific metrics; full reproducible evaluation implementation not verified.
Limitations: General biomedical coverage; a biology-only score requires an explicit subset and original metrics.

records.name: DMPKBench
records.description: Drug metabolism/pharmacokinetics, ADMET reasoning, interpretation and modeling.
notes: Access: Public code and several data subsets; ADMET-MPO reference answers withheld under licensing restrictions.
Grading: Subset-specific choice, numerical and open-response assessment; some open responses need model/expert grading.
Limitations: Questions being downloadable does not imply self-run scoring. Report subset coverage; large ADMET-MPO pool should not dominate other tasks.

records.name: BioMol-LLM-Bench
creators: Southern University of Science and Technology
records.description: 26 biomolecular LLM tasks across four levels, including classification, regression and generation.
notes: Access: Public BioMol-LLM-Bench repository with datasets and evaluation scripts.
Grading: Official task-specific metrics and output parsers in the evaluation code.
Limitations: LLM protocol over biological representations. Tool-augmented conditions must be reported separately.

records.name: DBench-Bio
creators: University of Science and Technology of China
records.description: Dynamic biological knowledge-discovery QA generated from newly published abstracts across 12 domains.
notes: Access: Public benchmark construction and evaluation repository.
Grading: Model-based answer grading on a five-point scale; freeze grader and generation settings.
Limitations: Monthly updates change the test set. Abstract-derived answer quality is a proxy, not experimental validation of a discovery.

records.name: SciR
records.description: Controlled deduction, induction and causal reasoning over developmental biology, drug relations and signaling.
notes: Access: Public task generation/evaluation code and author-linked HF dataset.
Grading: Verifiable task labels/rules/graph structure; evaluate each reasoning track with its official scorer.
Limitations: Formalized biological reasoning rather than an autonomous wet-lab workflow; report generated task settings.

records.name: SciFact — LLM protocol
records.description: Scientific claim verification with biomedical abstracts and supporting/refuting evidence.
notes: Access: Public SciFact corpus/repository and SciRIFF LLM task specification; confirm labels for chosen split.
Grading: SciRIFF prompted-LLM protocol: claim-label and evidence scoring; retain original task definitions.
Limitations: SciFact predates modern LLMs; included here for its documented prompted-LLM protocol. Do not double-count within ScholarQABench.

records.name: BioNLI — LLM inference protocol
records.description: Biomedical natural-language inference over abstracts with adversarially generated hypotheses.
notes: Access: Author release links for full/balanced training and development data; test set requires author contact.
Grading: Entailment/consistency classification using an explicit LLM prompt and official label mapping.
Limitations: Originally an NLI dataset; later LLM studies use it. Full/balanced releases share the same test set.

records.name: FrontierScience — biology
records.description: Expert biology problems from FrontierScience’s Olympiad and Research tracks.
notes: Access: Public openai/frontierscience release is a subset of the full benchmark; biology count/filter must be derived.
Grading: Reference-answer/rubric grading; keep Olympiad and Research scoring protocols separate.
Limitations: General-science benchmark with a biology slice; published full-suite results are not public-subset results.

records.name: SciEval — biology
records.description: Biology subset of a roughly 18k-question scientific knowledge, reasoning and application suite.
notes: Access: Public repository and HF dataset; BAI-SciEval URL resolves to OpenDFM/SciEval.
Grading: Official task-specific answer accuracy and open-response scoring.
Limitations: Do not report the all-science aggregate as biology; separate objective and judged task coverage.

records.name: SciAssess — biology
records.description: Biological/biomedical literature memorization, comprehension and analysis with article and supplement context.
notes: Access: Public code/questions; original PDFs and supporting information must be obtained separately by DOI.
Grading: Task-specific metrics; some depend on sentence-transformer models and custom evaluator logic.
Limitations: Document access is a practical blocker; a PDF/model context cap is not a measured prompt requirement.

records.name: SciCUEval — biology / biomedicine
records.description: Scientific context understanding over text, tables and knowledge graphs; biology/biomedicine slice.
notes: Access: Public evaluation code and author-linked Figshare dataset.
Grading: Task-dependent context relevance, absence, multi-source and inference metrics; verify judge needs by task.
Limitations: Ten component datasets cover different abilities; biology subset needs explicit task/domain mapping.

records.name: SciPredict — biology
records.description: Biology subset of 405 questions about empirical outcomes across biology, chemistry and physics.
notes: Access: Public SciPredict data and evaluation code.
Grading: Choice/numerical scoring plus model-based free-response grading, depending on question format.
Limitations: Predicting published experimental outcomes differs from executing new experiments; preserve temporal/contamination controls.

records.name: ResearchBench — biology / cell biology
records.description: Biology/cell-biology literature inspiration retrieval, hypothesis generation and ranking.
notes: Access: Paper and auto-gated ankilok/ResearchBench repository metadata public; gated contents not accessed.
Grading: Track-specific hypothesis/retrieval/ranking evaluation; executable grader configuration needs confirmation.
Limitations: Multi-discipline benchmark; direct hypothesis/ranking protocol listed here. An autonomous retrieval workflow needs its own protocol.

records.name: ScienceArena — biology
records.description: Recent science Olympiad problems, including a biology competition slice.
notes: Access: Paper identified; official runnable data/scorer release not located.
Grading: Paper-described answer/process-rubric evaluation; released scorer not verified.
Limitations: Distinct from OlympicArena; public competition questions may overlap other exam benchmarks.

records.name: OlympicArena — biology
records.description: Biology subset of 11,163 competition problems across seven disciplines; text and images.
notes: Access: Public OlympicArena repository, evaluation code and HF dataset.
Grading: Official answer extraction/correctness with task-format-specific handling.
Limitations: Multidisciplinary total is not biology count. Competition sources may overlap ScienceArena or exam collections.

records.name: MMMU — biology / basic medical science
records.description: College-level Biology and Basic Medical Science among multimodal academic subjects.
notes: Access: Public MMMU code and HF data; confirm availability of labels for the chosen split.
Grading: Official multiple-choice/open-answer parsing and accuracy.
Limitations: Keep biology and basic medical science separate; full MMMU stars/citations/likes cover all subjects.

records.name: MMMU-Pro — biology / basic medical science
records.description: More robust multimodal academic questions; biology/basic medical science slice.
notes: Access: Public MMMU-Pro dataset and code in the shared MMMU repository.
Grading: Official answer parsing/accuracy; standard and vision-only configurations differ.
Limitations: Shares source material with MMMU; revised options/vision conditions change difficulty. Repository stars are shared.

records.name: ScienceQA — biology
records.description: School-level science questions including biology, with optional image/text context.
notes: Access: Public author repository; repository-linked HF dataset mirror.
Grading: Multiple-choice accuracy using official split and answer extraction.
Limitations: Educational QA, not research execution. HF likes refer to the author-linked mirror, not an author-owned repository.

records.name: WMDP-Bio
records.description: WMDP-Bio: hazardous biological knowledge assessed by multiple-choice questions.
notes: Access: Public WMDP repository and cais/wmdp biology configuration.
Grading: Multiple-choice accuracy; preserve choice order and likelihood/generation protocol.
Limitations: Knowledge/unlearning proxy, not a direct measure of real-world experimental capability.

records.name: Virology Capabilities Test (VCT)
records.description: Virology Capabilities Test: specialist virology knowledge/reasoning, including visual material.
notes: Access: Public SecureBio description; full benchmark access is restricted/request-based.
Grading: Expert-authored question scoring; complete answer/scorer access requires confirmation with the provider.
Limitations: Record as an access-limited benchmark; do not substitute public examples for a full result.

records.name: BioTIER
records.description: 542 prompts testing targeted biological refusal: 398 refusal-target and 144 permitted requests.
notes: Access: Public paper; full prompt set subject to restricted researcher access.
Grading: Refusal/permission assessment; separate provider API blocks from model refusals and report both classes.
Limitations: Refusal behavior is distinct from biological competence. Do not collapse permitted and refused classes.

records.name: SPIKE-Bench
records.description: Biosecurity evaluation of model refusal and computationally assessed biological outputs.
notes: Access: Public pipeline repository; 631-prompt HF dataset is auto-gated.
Grading: Refusal, plausibility and computational proxy metrics; verify each evaluator and model dependency.
Limitations: Computational proxy scores are not experimental validation of biological activity.

records.name: BioEval — repository-stage suite
records.description: Repository-stage biology reasoning suite; base 296 / extended 400 items across 12 components.
notes: Access: Public repository and HF dataset; no independently established leaderboard evidence verified.
Grading: Released reference JSON/rubrics and evaluation framework; scorer reliability still needs independent validation.
Limitations: Early repository-stage suite, not equivalent evidence maturity to an established benchmark.

records.name: BioReasonBench — pilot
records.description: Five figure-based biological reasoning pilot cases.
notes: Access: Public pilot repository with cases and evaluation materials.
Grading: Concept/lexical proxy plus expert review; not yet a validated general-purpose judge.
Limitations: Tiny pilot with limited model comparisons; catalogued for coverage, not treated as a mature suite.

records.name: BioThreat-Eval — proxy suite
records.description: Repository-stage biological risk/refusal proxy evaluation.
notes: Access: Public framework and HF repository; code ships six benign proxy examples rather than the complete intended bank.
Grading: Cross-provider model judging and proxy risk summaries; independent validation required.
Limitations: Proxy risk scores do not establish real biological capabilities; release scope and fallback behavior must be explicit.

records.name: MicroVQA++ — announced evaluation
records.description: Microscopy reasoning dataset/evaluation proposal extending the MicroVQA research direction.
notes: Access: Paper and demo repository; dataset/code/model-result release still listed as pending.
Grading: Independent held-out protocol/scorer release not verified; paper describes evaluation of microscopy reasoning.
Limitations: Announced dataset/evaluation entry. Do not count as a new runnable benchmark until test protocol and assets are verified.

records.name: ProteinLMBench
records.description: ProteinLMBench: 944 protein-understanding MCQs for general-purpose language models.
notes: Access: Public ProteinLMDataset repository and separate ProteinLMBench HF evaluation dataset.
Grading: Multiple-choice answer accuracy under the official prompting/answer extraction protocol.
Limitations: An LLM knowledge/understanding benchmark, not ProteinGym or a dedicated protein-language-model fitness test.

records.name: BioProBench — step ordering (ORD)
records.description: BioProBench step ordering (ORD): recover the order of biological protocol steps.
notes: Access: Public ORD train/test JSON and official metric script.
Grading: Exact-match order accuracy and Kendall’s tau using Metrics/ORD.py.
Limitations: Additional task family within BioProBench, not an independent benchmark; shares paper/repository/dataset popularity.

records.name: BioProBench — protocol generation (GEN)
records.description: BioProBench protocol generation (GEN).
notes: Access: Public GEN train/test data and official metric script.
Grading: BLEU, keyword-based metrics and step recall/precision via Metrics/GEN.py.
Limitations: Protocol-text similarity is a proxy, not evidence of successful physical execution; shares BioProBench corpus.

records.name: BioProBench — protocol reasoning (REA)
records.description: BioProBench reasoning conditions, including REA-ERR and REA-GEN.
notes: Access: Public task files and reasoning/inference scripts; exact condition-to-split mapping must be pinned.
Grading: Official REA-ERR accuracy/precision/recall/consistency; verify REA-GEN grading separately.
Limitations: Reasoning-conditioned variants reuse BioProBench tasks; do not count them as independent question banks.

records.name: LAB-Bench — FigQA / TableQA, tool-free
records.description: LAB-Bench FigQA and TableQA scientific figure/table interpretation.
notes: Access: Public LAB-Bench release includes roughly 80% of full suite; private holdout excluded.
Grading: Official accuracy, precision and coverage with abstention.
Limitations: Complements existing text-only LAB-Bench row. Harbor FigQA is a different harness/protocol.

records.name: BioASQ — supplied-snippet factoid / list
records.description: BioASQ factoid/list biomedical QA with supporting snippets supplied to the model.
notes: Access: Year/batch-specific BioASQ data and public evaluation measures; registration may apply.
Grading: Official factoid ranking/MRR and list precision/recall/F1; retain accepted synonyms.
Limitations: Complements yes/no row; supplied-snippet protocol excludes model retrieval. Annual releases can overlap.

records.name: BioASQ — supplied-snippet ideal answers
records.description: BioASQ ideal-answer synthesis from supplied biomedical evidence snippets.
notes: Access: Year-specific reference answers and evaluation tools; challenge data may require registration.
Grading: Official ideal-answer metrics, including ROUGE and expert assessment; automatic metrics are only part of evaluation.
Limitations: Long-form answer quality is not the same outcome as factoid/list or yes/no accuracy.

records.name: GPQA Main / Extended — biology
records.description: Graduate-level biology questions in GPQA Main and Extended, beyond the existing Diamond row.
notes: Access: Public password-packaged author release and gated HF dataset; Main/Extended/Diamond overlap.
Grading: Four-choice accuracy with official option shuffling and prompt settings.
Limitations: Treat conservatively as ID because of overlap with GPQA Diamond; not a fresh held-out suite.

records.name: BioSecBench-Refusal — meta framing
records.description: BioSecBench-Refusal meta framing: judge accept/refuse decisions for 61 routine and 46 risk-bearing tasks.
notes: Access: Two public examples and methodology; full 107-task set and sensitive reference rationales restricted.
Grading: Decision/refusal assessment under the official meta framing; report routine versus red-team behavior and API blocks separately.
Limitations: Same task family as direct-framing row; meta evaluation asks for a decision, not completion of the underlying analysis.

records.name: SciKnowEval v2 — biology open-ended tasks
records.description: Open-ended biology task families in SciKnowEval v2, including relation extraction and generation.
notes: Access: Public v2 dataset, prompts and evaluator; judge API and embedding assets required for affected tasks.
Grading: Task-specific scoring using GPT judging and/or word-vector similarity; official default judge gpt-4o.
Limitations: Official code skips GPT-scored tasks if its API key is absent. Complements the existing closed-choice row.

records.name: LiveProteinBench — repository-stage suite
records.description: Protein-related LLM predictions using sequences, optionally with structure images.
notes: Access: Public task/prompt files and OpenAI-compatible inference runner; scorer/label completeness needs an audit.
Grading: Runner saves model answers; complete task-specific scoring contract not verified from release documentation.
Limitations: Repository-stage LLM benchmark; no peer-reviewed paper or validated full-suite grader identified.

records.name: SciQ — biology
records.description: Biology questions within 13,679 crowdsourced science questions.
notes: Access: Public allenai/sciq dataset; upstream lm-eval task exists, but biology subset mapping needs verification.
Grading: Four-choice accuracy under an explicit supplied-support or closed-book protocol.
Limitations: General science bank, not a prepackaged biology benchmark. The support passage changes the evaluation condition.

records.name: SuperGPQA — biology
records.description: Graduate-level biology subset within SuperGPQA’s 285 disciplines.
notes: Access: Public authors’ repository and m-a-p/SuperGPQA dataset.
Grading: Official choice extraction/accuracy with sample and taxonomy-level aggregation.
Limitations: Not GPQA; incorporates some transformed data from existing benchmarks, so inspect overlap before using as a holdout.

records.name: C-Eval — biology
records.description: Chinese middle-school, high-school and college biology subjects in C-Eval.
notes: Access: Public dataset/evaluator; test labels withheld and submissions scored by the official service.
Grading: Four-choice accuracy; public validation labels, externally scored private test labels.
Limitations: Language and exam level affect comparison. Public validation performance is not canonical test performance.

records.name: CMMLU — biology
records.description: Chinese biology subjects in the 67-subject CMMLU knowledge/reasoning suite.
notes: Access: Public subject-organized development/test data, code and HF release.
Grading: Four-choice accuracy with official zero-/few-shot prompting.
Limitations: Separate from C-Eval; report subject-level results and avoid pooling clinical subjects without stating the scope.

records.name: AGIEval — Gaokao biology
records.description: Chinese Gaokao biology questions in AGIEval.
notes: Access: Public repository contains v1.1 data and scoring code; biology updated with 2023 questions.
Grading: Official answer extraction and accuracy; pin dataset version and prompt mode.
Limitations: Likely source overlap with other Gaokao collections; do not assume independent test questions.

records.name: GAOKAO-Bench — biology
records.description: Chinese Gaokao biology objective and subjective questions.
notes: Access: Public data and objective/subjective evaluation code.
Grading: Objective-answer scoring plus model/expert grading for subjective questions; keep the two reports separate.
Limitations: Overlaps exam sources used by AGIEval; whole-exam weighted scores are not a biology accuracy.
